content: Merhaba, motor sesinin ne zaman başladığını sorabilir miyim? Yaklaşık 2 haftadır var.
Anlıyorum. Bu tür titreşimler genellikle motor damperi veya egzoz bağlantısından kaynaklanıyor. Yarın sabah bakıyorum.
İnceleme sonucunda damperin yanı sıra egzoz bağlantısında da gevşeme tespit ettim. Ek 1 gün daha gerekebilir.
Tekneyi 1 Mart sabahı 8.30'da marina girişinde bırakacağım. Bir not bırakmanızı ister misiniz?
Tamam, oradayız. Tekne girişinde sizi karşılayacağız. Yaklaşık 2 gün sürecek.
Nem sensörlerinin kabinde nereye monte edileceğini öğrenebilir miyim?
Acil durum! Sintine dolmaya devam ediyor, lütfen bugün gelin!
Yolculuğumdayım, 2 saat içinde oradayım.
Pompa değiştirildi ama kaptan mahallinde küçük çizik var. Bu nasıl oldu?
Teklif için teşekkürler. İçeriği inceliyorum.
Tabii, sorularınız olursa lütfen sorun. Motor için en kaliteli malzemeyi kullanıyoruz.
Teak güverte tamiri için başlangıç tarihi teyit ediliyor mu?
Evet, 15 Nisan sabahı 9'da başlıyoruz. Malzemeler hazır.
Ek nem giderici için ne kadar süre beklenmesi gerekiyor?
Malzeme 2 iş günü içinde gelecek. Hemen ardından kurulumu tamamlıyoruz.
Has the replacement bearing arrived yet? We need the vessel back in service by the 15th — we have a charter group joining in Positano and the captain is asking for confirmation.
Good news — MAN Diesel parts arrived this morning from Hamburg. We have started the installation. The engine should be back together by end of day Thursday and ready for a warm-up run.
Excellent. Can you confirm the sea trial date? I would like to be present if at all possible. Please send photo documentation from this week to my email as well.

Sea trial is scheduled for Friday 11 July at 09:00. Please be at the marina by 08:45. We will run the engine to full load under load. Photo documentation from this week has been uploaded to the work log.

Admin note — owner has confirmed charter commitment on 15 July. This request is time-critical. Ensure provider is on track for completion by 12 July to allow owner handover and captain sign-off before departure.
We have two offers waiting. The Teknik Servis quote looks competitive but I need clarification — does the scope include the shore power inlet inspection, or is that charged separately?

Yes, our offer includes the shore power inlet, all circuit breakers, battery isolation switch and full nav instrument wiring check. We also provide a written audit report on completion at no extra charge.
Thank you for clarifying that. What is the earliest start date if we proceed with your offer? We are happy to mobilise quickly.
We can mobilise on 5 July. The full job should take one working day. We carry all standard circuit breaker sizes in the service van so there should be no need for a return visit.

Admin note — two competing offers active (IDs 9104, 9105). Owner is engaged with Provider Teknik Servis. Remind owner to formally accept or decline both offers within 48 hours per platform policy to avoid offer expiry.
When can the navigation system integration start? We are planning to leave for the Bosphorus cruise on 12 July and need the chartplotter calibrated and sea-trialled before departure.
We are confirmed for 8 July starting at 09:00. Our technician will bring the Raymarine Axiom Pro 16 pre-configured with your regional cartography. Installation should take one full working day.
Perfect. The vessel is at Fenerbahçe Marina berth 7B. Please ask the marina office for access if I am not there — I will leave your names at the security gate the evening before.
Noted. We will call ahead to confirm on the 7th. Please ensure the existing chartplotter is accessible and not locked — we need to remove it cleanly to reuse the flush-mount bracket.
Admin note — assignment 9602 confirmed for 8 July. Provider to verify chartplotter mounting compatibility and AIS antenna coax routing before arrival to avoid day-of scope creep.
How is the antifouling application progressing? We are already halfway through June and I am keen to get back in the water before the peak summer period ends.
Blasting and surface preparation are complete. First antifouling coat is approximately 30% applied — working starboard to port. No osmotic damage found, which is very good for a vessel this age.
Good to hear. Please make absolutely sure the topcoat is Hempel Classic in Racing Blue — the same shade as last year. I do not want to repaint the boot stripe to match a different finish.
Confirmed — Hempel Classic Racing Blue is on order and arrives tomorrow morning. We will apply the topcoat once the antifouling second coat has cured for the full 24-hour period.
Admin note — owner topcoat specification (Hempel Classic Racing Blue) confirmed and acknowledged by provider. Logged for quality assurance check on completion sign-off.

I have received the invoice for 47 hours. Our written agreement was a maximum of 30 hours for shaft alignment and bearing replacement. I did not authorise additional work and I am formally disputing this invoice through the platform.

We understand your concern. The additional 17 hours resulted from severe electrolytic corrosion found in the engine mount studs during shaft disassembly — impossible to detect beforehand. We attempted to contact you twice on 18 June before proceeding, as delay risked catastrophic shaft misalignment.

I have no record of any calls on 18 June. The platform service agreement is clear — any work beyond the agreed scope requires written consent before proceeding. You should have stopped work and waited for my authorisation regardless of the risk.

We have call logs showing two outbound attempts at 14:02 and 16:31 on 18 June. The corrosion risk to the propeller shaft was imminent — proceeding was in the vessel owner's best interest to prevent a significantly larger repair cost. We are willing to discuss a partial adjustment.

Admin note — dispute 9901 filed by owner (user 10004) on 18 June 2026. Invoice variance is 57% beyond agreed scope (17 of 30 hours unauthorised). Provider claims emergency escalation with documented call attempts; owner denies contact. Flagging for senior compliance review. Platform arbitration to be initiated within 3 business days per dispute resolution policy.
